review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C scenario. The original PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical input without asserting a human Decision, so ready with no decision blocker is appropriate; a material unresolved DEC-001 in paired B must instead block at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, the exact five-file writable binding scope, and the implementation/independent-verification task split agree with the specification. The complete implementation owners support the proposed scope, including admission ordering, abort cleanup, reentrancy, and actual fixed/sliding-window start eligibility. The supplied build and nz discovery evidence supports generated declarations and compile-time checks in test-d/index.test-d.ts without separately maintained dist owners or configuration edits. Role-specific assignment expectations are supported by the supplied active trusted capability claims, membership, availability, and independent reviewer configuration, without relying on personas or pending legacy claims. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; the supplied provenance explains the different source digest domains and PRD trimming. The original specification's preparation-state fields are historical, not contradictory current readiness expectations. No candidate outputs informed this review. I reviewed the supplied evidence only, did not execute code or independently recompute digests, and do not treat this approval as a human attestation, task authorization, or implementation verification.
